description.value:
You come from a humble corner of the galaxy, but your home village already treats you as its champion after a single defining act — standing against a tyrant's agents, breaking a corrupt decree, or leading a militia when no one else would.

Whatever that moment was, it convinced you that the common folk deserve someone willing to stand between them and whatever threatens them, and it's shaped every choice you've made since.

toolProficiencies: One type of artisan's implements, biochemist's kit, or chef's kit
system.equipment: A set of tools of your choice, a set of common clothes, and a belt pouch containing 100 credits.
